pool.text: Tripolitania including Misrata came under the regency of the Ottoman Empire.
Osman al-Aghdam led a rebellion against the Ottomans and their local allies.
The Aghdams were left in an inferior position after their eventual defeat.
Italy was unable to reach Misrata until this year following their invasion.
Ramadan al-Swehli's Misratan army dealt a major blow to the Italians at Qasr Abu Hadi.
Ottoman influence waned in Misrata after Nuri Bey was recalled to Istanbul.
The construction of the road connecting Zuwara to Misrata was completed.
The Via Balbia was built, connecting Misrata with Tripoli and Benghazi.
The Kingdom of Italy created the Fourth Shore with Libya's coastal provinces.
A new railway station built in Misrata was destroyed by British attacks.
Asswehly Sports Club was founded.
Misrata witnessed mass riots in response to alleged vote rigging during parliamentary elections.
Alittihad Misurata Sports Club was founded.
Muammar Gaddafi's coup overthrew the monarchy of King Idris.
Alahly Misurata Sports Club was founded.
Assabah Sports Club was founded.
Aschumooe Sports Club was founded.
Attasaddy Misurata Sports Club was founded.
Small demonstrations took place in Misrata in solidarity with protesters in Benghazi.
The city held its first free elections after a month of organizing.
